title: Low-altitude Economy: Building the Flying Car, Air Tourism and Drone Logistics Industry
what_it_is: Low-altitude Economy: Building the Flying Car, Air Tourism and Drone Logistics Industry

sections.label: Global drone and eVTOL market
sections.summary: The global drone market including military is about US$30 billion, and commercial eVTOL about $3.1 billion, projected to reach $216 billion by 2035.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The global drone market, of course, including military, is about US$30 billion today.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And eVTOL, in the commercial side, is probably about $3.1 billion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is projected to reach $216 billion by 2035, with a compounded annual growth rate of 51.8%.

sections.label: Report on Singapore output and jobs
sections.summary: A report by a now-defunct private company said Singapore had about $4 billion output contribution and about 1,500 jobs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Couple of years back, about maybe four years back, there is a report by a private company, no more in existence but when they planned to deploy here, said that in Singapore, there is an output of about $4 billion contribution to the economy with about 1,500 jobs.

sections.label: NTU eVTOL design unveiled
sections.summary: At the Airshow, NTU unveiled the design of an eVTOL that has done its initial hover test in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In the Airshow, the Nanyang Technological University (NTU) unveiled the design of an eVTOL that has done its initial hover test in Singapore.

sections.label: Drone projects and national strategy
sections.summary: ST Engineering, NTU and SIT have drone or eVTOL projects, and a national strategy for low-altitude economy is proposed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: ST Engineering has a 100-kg payload logistic drone due for certification in I think 2028.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: NTU's 200 kg eVTOL prototype unveiled in 2026, led by Prof James Wang; and in the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT), 80 kg moving to a 200-kg payload, led by Prof Victor Wang.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: We should have a strategy, Mr Deputy Speaker, a national strategy for low-altitude economy.

sections.label: Maritime Drone Estate launch
sections.summary: MPA launched Singapore's first Maritime Drone Estate in April 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MPA has launched Singapore's first Maritime Drone Estate in April 2021.

sections.label: Cheap storage in neighbouring land
sections.summary: Neighbouring countries have land and plantations where cheap container ports, storage or logistics centres could store goods for airlift.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Another example, our neighbours have land, many plantations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And if you plant container ports or storage facilities or logistics centres in such locations, which is really cheap, and you can airlift it out, so you can actually store seasonal goods, you can store expensive value-added materials where the storage space is really, really cheap.

sections.label: Air mobility business model funding
sections.summary: The speaker recommends the National Research Foundation treat air mobility as a white space and allocate money for industry, universities and research institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, moving facilities or bus or trucks or bicycles into the air is not just simply moving into the air.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is also coming with a different business model.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Therefore, I would recommend that the National Research Foundation consider this to be a white space and really aggressively allocate some good money for the industry, and the universities and research institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This is the chance for us to have aircraft design engineers, providing good jobs and also generating good economic output for our people.

sections.label: eVTOL viability in Singapore
sections.summary: The passage states eVTOLs may not be viable extensively in Singapore due to congested airspace and a well-connected ground transport network.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, it may not be viable to deploy eVTOLs extensively as a domestic transport option.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: EVTOLS are similar to helicopters, and are more viable in places with severe traffic congestion, and where point-to-point flight can cut down travel time considerably.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: They will have marginal utility in Singapore, where airspace is congested and given that we already benefit from a well-connected ground transport network.

sections.label: Drones reducing man-hours
sections.summary: Using drones in this manner can potentially reduce required man-hours by up to 70%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Using drones in this manner can potentially reduce the required man-hours by up to 70%.

sections.label: Commercial drone operations at higher altitudes
sections.summary: In 2025, some commercial drone operations were allowed at higher altitudes in designated areas all days of the week for façade inspections.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: In 2025, we allowed some commercial drone operations to be conducted at higher altitudes in designated areas for all days of the week for façade inspections.

sections.label: Enhanced real-time airspace clearance
sections.summary: In 2025, real-time airspace clearance processes were enhanced so operators can obtain immediate clearance at certain heights and locations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: In 2025, we also enhanced real-time airspace clearance processes to expedite approval of drone activities, such that operators can now obtain immediate clearance for drone operations at certain heights and locations.

sections.label: Polytechnics as Unmanned Aircraft Training Organisations
sections.summary: Four of five polytechnics are approved as Unmanned Aircraft Training Organisations and conduct practical drone operations courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Four out of our five polytechnics are also approved as Unmanned Aircraft Training Organisations, and conduct practical courses in drone operations.

sections.label: Unmanned Aircraft Flying Areas launched
sections.summary: CAAS has launched two Unmanned Aircraft Flying Areas at Pandan Reservoir and Dover Road for enthusiasts' recreational operations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: CAAS has launched two Unmanned Aircraft Flying Areas at Pandan Reservoir and Dover Road where enthusiasts can gather and conduct their own recreational operations.

sections.label: Chinese cities trialling drones
sections.summary: Chinese cities are trialling drones for urban uses such as deliveries, façade inspections, traffic monitoring and enforcement, and search and rescue.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Chinese cities are trialling drones for a multitude of urban use cases, including food and parcel deliveries, high-rise façade inspections, traffic monitoring and enforcement, and search and rescue operations, many of which Singapore may also wish to explore.

sections.label: Ministry of Transport drone plans
sections.summary: The Ministry of Transport will consult stakeholders and focus on driving public sector drone usage while working with the private sector on commercial use cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: Because we do have a 30-minute timeframe for this Adjournment Motion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We agree with Dr Neo that it is important to bring together the wider ecosystem and we will consult all stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Ministry of Transport's immediate focus is to drive the usage of drones more extensively, especially by the public sector and this is because we already have many potential use cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And we will also continue to work with the private sector on commercial use cases while continuing to emphasise safety and being cognisant of our unique operating environment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Allow me to end off by assuring the House that we will continue to work together closely to safely and responsibly harness the benefits of low-altitude technologies for our transport sector and Singapore’s wider economy.
